The *Kodha Sutta* (*Itivuttaka* 4; PTS It 2) is a short discourse located in the first chapter of the *Itivuttaka* (*Ekakanipāta*) within the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The sutta delivers a succinct exhortation on overcoming anger (*kodha*), declaring that the full abandonment of this single quality guarantees the fruit of non-return (*anāgāmitā*) [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral records an extant Chinese parallel to the discourse preserved at T 765.16 (恚) [SuttaCentral].
